newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank shares bring down Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares bring down Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius market index Semdex lost 0.36 points to 393.68 on Friday on declining prices of State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) and commerce stocks, bourse officials said.
Turnover rose to 14.21 million rupees ($694,000) on 385,272 shares from 22.79 million rupees on 1,010,757 shares on Wednesday. The bourse opens on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
State Bank of Mauritius eased 20 cents to 12.80 rupees on 1,000 shares while Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 89 rupees on 65,582 shares.

In the commerce sector, conglomerates Rogers lost a rupee to 104 on 26,329 shares but Ireland Blyth Ltd was unchanged at 17.90 on 16,870 shares. Shell gained 20 cents to 20.40 on 4,200 shares and Happy World Foods remained to 15.80 on 1,200 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) gained 60 cents to 41.50 rupees on 27,355 shares, and Mount lost 10 cents to 23.40 but was not traded.
"Investors reacted positively in MTMD stock after the announcement of Lonrho's deal with Illovo Sugar Ltd," a broker said. Lonrho owns 58 percent of the MTMD stock.
South African market leader Illovo Sugar Ltd said on Thursday it was taking over Lonrho Sugar Corp Ltd to create Africa's largest sugar group.
In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts was stable at 50.50 rupees on 4,001 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 37 on 18,168 shares and Grand Baie Hotel remained steady at 46.80.

Promotion And Development rose 40 cents to 14.80 on 68,072 shares, Policy gained 10 cents to 4.25 on 11,893 shares, Mauritius Development Investment Trust was stable at 7.70 on 77,454 shares and Fincorp was unchanged at 72.50 on 600 shares.
Air Mauritius was stable at 42.10 rupees on 8,450 shares.
